description_en: Queries the list of created trails
description_zh: 查看已创建的跟踪列表
kebab_example: aliyun actiontrail describe-trails --include-shadow-trails true --name-list audit-log,trail-test2 --include-organization-trail false --api-version 2017-12-04 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeTrails

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to display shadow trails. Valid values:

false (default): Shadow trails are not displayed.
true: Shadow trails are displayed
parameters.help_zh:
是否显示影子跟踪，取值：

false（默认值）：不显示。
true：显示
parameters.name: include_shadow_trails

parameters.help_en: The names of the trails to query, separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的跟踪名称列表，以半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: name_list

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query multi-account trails. Valid values:   

true: Multi-account trails are queried.

false (default): Multi-account trails are not queried. Only single-account trails are queried
parameters.help_zh:
是否查询多账号跟踪。取值：   

true：查询多账号跟踪。

false（默认值）：不查询多账号跟踪，即查询单账号跟踪
parameters.name: include_organization_trail

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the trail was created

EventRW.description_en:
The read/write type of the delivered events. Valid values:
Write (default): write events.
Read: read events.
All: both read and write events
EventRW.description_zh:
投递事件的读写类型，取值：
Write（默认值）：写类型。
Read：读类型。
All：读类型和写类型

HomeRegion.description_en: The home region of the trail

IsOrganizationTrail.description_en:
Indicates whether the trail is a multi-account trail. Valid values:

false (default): No.
true: Yes
IsOrganizationTrail.description_zh:
是否是多账号跟踪，取值：

false（默认值）：否。
true：是

MnsTopicArn.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the MNS topic that receives ActionTrail events. Format: `acs:mns:<Region>:<Account ID>:/topics/<topicName>`. If this parameter is specified, a message is sent to the MNS topic when events are delivered to OSS
MnsTopicArn.description_zh: 用于接收操作审计事件的MNS Topic的ARN，格式为：`acs:mns:<Region>:<Account ID>:/topics/<topicName>`。填写此参数后，向OSS中投递事件时，会产生一条消息投递到该MNS Topic。

OssBucketName.description_en: The name of the OSS bucket

OssKeyPrefix.description_en: The prefix of the file name in the OSS bucket
OssKeyPrefix.description_zh: OSS存储空间文件名的前缀

RoleName.description_en: The name of the RAM role that the user allows ActionTrail to assume
RoleName.description_zh: 用户允许操作审计服务扮演的RAM角色名称

SlsProjectArn.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the Simple Log Service project to which the trail delivers events
SlsProjectArn.description_zh: 跟踪投递目标的日志服务项目在阿里云唯一的资源名称（Aliyun Resource Name，ARN）

SlsWriteRoleArn.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the role that ActionTrail assumes to deliver logs to the destination Simple Log Service project
SlsWriteRoleArn.description_zh: 操作审计向目标日志服务项目投递日志时，扮演的角色在阿里云唯一的资源名称（Aliyun Resource Name，ARN）

StartLoggingTime.description_en: The time when the user last enabled the trail
StartLoggingTime.description_zh: 用户上一次开启该跟踪的时间

Status.description_en:
The status of the trail. Valid values:
Disable: The trail is stopped.
Enable: The trail is enabled.  

Fresh: The trail is created but not enabled
Status.description_zh:
跟踪状态，取值：
Disable：停止。
Enable：开启。  

Fresh：已创建跟踪，但未开启

StopLoggingTime.description_en: The time when the user last stopped the trail
StopLoggingTime.description_zh: 用户上一次停止该跟踪的时间

TrailRegion.description_en:
The region of the trail. Example values:
All (default): Events from all regions are tracked.
ap-southeast-1: Only events from the Singapore region are tracked.
ap-southeast-5: Only events from the Jakarta region are tracked
TrailRegion.description_zh:
跟踪的地域，取值示例：
All（默认值）：跟踪全部地域的事件。
cn-hangzhou ：仅跟踪杭州地域的事件 。
cn-beijing：仅跟踪北京地域的事件

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the trail configuration was last updated
UpdateTime.description_zh: 跟踪配置上次更新的时间
